mechanism: Albuterol's beta-2 adrenergic stimulation may antagonize perphenazine's antipsychotic effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; perphenazine's alpha-blocking properties may potentiate albuterol's cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and cardiac effects; consider alternative antipsychotic if respiratory disease requires high-dose albuterol therapy.
